sources.title: Operação All In, first-instance sentence, part 2
sources.publisher: 3rd Federal Criminal Court of Campo Grande / TRF3
sources.claim: TRF3 primary trial judgment, dispositive on PDF pp. 495–497, individually convicts Gerson Palermo of cocaine trafficking under Article 33 of Law 11.343/2006 at first instance; 59 years, 9 months and 1 day; Articles 33, 35 and laundering. The 20 August 2019 TRF3 bulletin dates the judgment to 19 August 2019. Later appeal outcome and custody are not asserted.
